preserved.subject: Economics
preserved.question_a: A consumer price index is commonly used to measure changes in the:
options_a: average prices of a selected basket of goods and services
number of people in the labour force
volume of rainfall in a year
total land area of a country
preserved.question_b: Which measure is commonly used to summarise inequality in the distribution of income?
preserved.reason: The consumer price index tracks average price changes in a representative basket; the Gini coefficient summarises income inequality. They are different measures and learning outcomes.
